name: Experiments 4
description: v1's Experiments 4, The Egg's sibling: 9996 colored quarks (uud + udd, nuclear charge 10) and electrons (nuclear charge -10/3) in a 2e5 disk under v1's force map 2 with a wider Yukawa core (b = 0.2), its color force (three times stronger than The Egg's), 1/d Coulomb and 1/d gravity, in a box of half-size 1e6. Scripted like v1 (times are v1's seconds × 60): G jumps by 1e41 at t = 120 and the soup collapses, G drops 100-fold at t = 300, again with a tenfold drag at t = 3600, and the drag eases tenfold at t = 4200. v1's quadratic drag (deceleration c·|v|·v/m) is the force 'Drag (v1)', exerted by one fixed, otherwise inert marker particle (q2 = 1) at the origin (the 1e-30 under its square root keeps the velocity derivative finite at rest), so the scene runs with the Euler step like v1; v1's random force noise is not reproduced.

forces.name: Nuclear (v1 force map 2)
forces.expression: -k * n_i * n_j * (a * exp(-x / b) - c * x)

forces.name: Color (v1)
forces.expression: k * n_i * n_j * (5 * (cr_i * cr_j + cg_i * cg_j + cb_i * cb_j) - 2 * (cr_i + cg_i + cb_i) * (cr_j + cg_j + cb_j)) / 3
